hooks.authorization: content_secret_scans=true and named kind in _content_secret_scan_kinds and 1-2 exact same-scope regional Build names
hooks.root_remaining: Root owns all catalog, registry, planner, option admission, selection metadata, dependency scheduling and installation hooks; none changed here.

coverage.label: observed_manifest_generations_only
coverage.native_source: results.artifactManifest only; build inputs, configured artifact path globs and numArtifacts are never coverage
coverage.manifest: Bounded newline-delimited snake_case ArtifactResult records, generation-bearing gs:// locations, nested file_hash records of MD5 type 2; unsupported/empty/duplicate/excessive records UNKNOWN
coverage.generation: Resolve manifest generation via native metadata; manifest media and every artifact metadata/media GET pinned by generation and ifGenerationMatch; media generation, type, length, range and encoding checks inherited
coverage.binding: Native CRM v3 project ID/number plus exact native bucket projectNumber and source provenance checked before destination reads; all manifest destinations bound before artifact reads
coverage.receipts: Consumer independently checks exact request IDs, native row/envelope provenance, marker coverage/provenance, GET/200/collected status, exact operation/resource multiset, descriptor bindings, and nested pinned detector outcomes. Safe per-receipt binding descriptors preserve observed generation, bucket hash and selected reader identity without persisting object names or manifest content.
coverage.historical_limit: A resolved current manifest generation, its recorded artifact generations and MD5 fields do not prove an immutable relationship to historical build bytes; no historical or whole-build secret-absence claim.

formats: strict UTF-8 supported text/JSON/YAML/TOML/XML/JavaScript content types
ZIP, tar, tar.gz through existing selected-archive MIME dispatch and bounded text-member parser
unknown_conditions: nonterminal/foreign/ambiguous Build identity or invalid timestamps
missing native project/bucket source binding or partial native coverage
external, signed, globbed, percent-encoded or traversing URIs
denied, redirected, ranged, compressed, truncated, overlong or budget-limited reads
unsupported/binary/nested archive members or unsupported artifact content types
one detector unavailable or version/coverage mismatch

safety.metadata_reader: existing uncached bounded Cloud Build log _json_get helper
safety.network_tests: socket.socket.connect blocked with pytest.MonkeyPatch; all cloud responses fake; scanner subprocess uses existing no-verification/no-update flags

sources.supports: Manifest object location, generation-bearing per-artifact location, MD5 type 2 semantics; overwrite caveat
Results.artifactManifest is produced GCS artifact manifest; ArtifactResult and FileHashes schemas
Official Go writer encodes each ArtifactResult with json.Encoder.Encode; native snake_case file_hash, nested FileHashes and MD5 numeric enum; MD5 column bytes may be base64 of a base64 string
sources.limitation: Archived local-builder implementation corroborates exact supported layout, not every hosted writer variant; other variants UNKNOWN

sources.supports: Pure planner explicitly separates sources from produced artifacts and leaves manifest traversal unresolved

validation.real_engine_positive: FAIL with both detector attributions and hidden token
validation.real_engine_negative: PASS with both complete pinned engines
validation.command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import inspect, runpy, pytest
m = runpy.run_path('tests/test_gcp_cloudbuild_artifact_secret_review_20261019.py')
for name, f in m.items():
    if name.startswith('test_'):
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
            f(mp) if inspect.signature(f).parameters else f()
        print(name, 'PASS')
PY
